content.title: The Hoist
content.theme: A keep whose two landings are joined by one cage on a chain.
content.premise: spec-0031 acceptance criterion 9: the lift, authored entirely in campaign JSON. Every part of it is a configured use of a v0.10 primitive and no verb names a lift. Two things about this fixture are consequences of the engine rather than of the fiction, and both are executing tests in `crates/compiler/tests/v10_lift.rs` rather than comments here: there is no lever INSIDE the car (any affordance in the car volume is DW0542, correctly), and there is no shaft — a runtime region is a box CENTRED on a prefab anchor, so the car's deck, its arrival cell and a shaft-bottom lethal volume cannot be named, and no prefab in the library ships anchors for them. `hello-room`'s four anchors are exactly consumed by two car stations and two call levers, which is why this campaign casts no NPC.
